variants.name: Typographic Index
variants.brief: Text and type only, near-monochrome. Home is the name, a face, a scattered keyword cloud of what he works in with the largest words at the centre, and a large-text index of six sections. Each section slides over the index in place, and every list row inside opens its own page: a talk with its video and writeup, a post in full, a project, a platform group, a CV role. No page loads, hash-routed, mobile-first motion.
